# Random workloads, STAGGERED interactive periods (13/15/17 ms): mix2:C,W,I.
# Generated by experiments/gen_random_mix.py, seed 2026; part 2/3. Same mixes and
# policies as random_mix_*.txt. Written because that run's M1/M3a/M5 failed for a reason
# that was my prediction's fault: all interactive processes slept exactly 15 ms, so
# with two or more they woke in lockstep and queued behind each other (~0.5 ms),
# which no scheduler can avoid. These predictions were written BEFORE this run:
#   M1'. In at least 90% of the mixes that have an interactive process, fair and hfair
#        give p95 wake-up latency <= 100 us.
#   M2.  hint <= hfair <= 1.05 x fair in context switches, in every mix (a repeat of M2,
#        which held 30/30 on the first random run).
#   M3a'. hfair with WRONG hints: interactive p95 <= 100 us in at least 90% of those mixes.
#   M3b. hint with WRONG hints exceeds 10 ms in at least a third of the mixes that have
#        both CPU-bound and interactive processes.
#   M4'. Makespan within 1.5% across rr/mlfq/fair/hint/hfair/hfair16 in every mix.
#   M5'. In every mix with an interactive process, rr's AND mlfq's p95 are worse than fair's.
#   M6.  (out of sample for the aging finding F11) hint with correct hints: p95 <= 100 us
#        in at least 90% of the mixes with <= 5 CPU-bound processes, AND above 100 us in
#        at least one mix with >= 7 CPU-bound processes.
# A prediction that fails gets reported as failed.
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,0,2 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:6,3,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:2,3,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,2,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,0,1 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:7,3,1 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 rr
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 fair
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:8,3,2 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 rr

repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 hint
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:5,2,0 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix2:1,1,3 rr
